close_reason: Added PartialEq, Eq to pkix-path::DerError to match pkix-revocation::DerError. Both opaque newtypes now have identical derives. Builds clean.
description:
Pass 2 idiom finding under epic PKIX-qwzx.

Two crates each define an opaque `pub struct DerError(der::Error)` newtype with the
identical purpose: insulate the public API from `der::Error` semver breakage.
Their derives differ:

`pkix-path/src/lib.rs:71-72`:
```rust
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct DerError(der::Error);
```

`pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:42-43`:
```rust
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct DerError(der::Error);
```

`der::Error` does derive `PartialEq, Eq` upstream (verified by the fact that the
revocation version compiles), so both could and should have the same derives.

Picking either way is fine, but they MUST agree. The pragmatic answer is to add
`PartialEq, Eq` to `pkix-path::DerError` to match `pkix-revocation` — this is a
prerequisite for adding `PartialEq, Eq` to `pkix-path::Error` (see PKIX-qwzx.15).

Fix: align derives. Either drop them from `pkix-revocation::DerError` (semver
break for that crate) or add them to `pkix-path::DerError` (no break).

Recommend: add `PartialEq, Eq` to `pkix-path::DerError`.
title: (IDIOM) P3: pkix-path::DerError lacks PartialEq/Eq while pkix-revocation::DerError has them — same newtype, different derives
